requirements.evidence: Required members tabs are absent from the diff; app/Livewire/Entity/Queues.php:102-105 returns collect() under an Eloquent\Collection return type; rename has no UI and passes a null slug (Queues.php:111-131); Serve.php:56-75 has no rate limit; and Serve.php:79-99 resolves selectedQueueId without a call authorization.

conventions.evidence: Domain writes correctly go through actions (Queues.php:80,131,185) and name uses #[Validate] (Queues.php:25-26), but Serve.php:29,67 leaves mode unvalidated, queues.blade.php:38-39 puts an Eloquent query in the view, and no tests or docs/CHANGELOG updates accompany the change.

security.evidence: Write actions are scoped and authorized (Queues.php:90,124-125,150-151,182-183), but Serve.php:79-99 loads waiting tickets for any client-supplied selectedQueueId without authorize('call', $queue), Serve.php:67 uses an unvalidated client-controlled mode, and callNext() has no rate limiting.

tests.evidence: change.diff contains no tests/ files or any Pest/PHPUnit cases; there are no feature, unauthorized-call, or tamper tests for either new Livewire component.

simplicity.evidence: The component reuses the existing actions and computed properties (Queues.php:49-51,101-115; Serve.php:40-54), but duplicates scoped queue resolution, moves a query into Blade (queues.blade.php:38-39), and leaves unused state (Queues.php:34).

readability.evidence: Methods are short and mostly clearly named, but role handling is inconsistent (Serve.php:49 compares enum ->value strings while queues.blade.php:85 compares enum cases), and dead/unused code remains (Queues.php:34; Serve.php:6,10,18).

scope.evidence: Every changed file serves the queues/serve/tabs/nav task (change.diff:1-583); no unrelated refactors or features are added.

issues.explanation: getAccessGrantsProperty() declares Illuminate\Database\Eloquent\Collection but returns collect(), an Illuminate\Support\Collection, so rendering the Queues page while no access modal is open throws a TypeError and the page cannot load; Serve has the same return-type mismatch when no membership is found.

render() resolves the client-supplied selectedQueueId and loads its waiting tickets without authorize('call', $queue), so an employee can read tickets from any active queue in the entity even without a call grant.
A foreign or missing selectedQueueId reaches findOrFail() in render() and returns a 404 instead of the required no-tickets/ui.serve_empty state.
The view tests @if ($tickets), but an empty Eloquent Collection is truthy, so a selected queue with no waiting tickets renders an empty table instead of the required ui.serve_empty empty state.
The members tabs requirement (activeTab/setActiveTab, role="tablist", invites content only on the invites tab) is not implemented; only the members_tab_* language keys were added.
The Rename button only calls startRename, but the detail modal renders no rename input or rename/Cancel controls, so the rename flow cannot be completed in the UI.
rename() passes null for the slug argument to UpdateQueue, so the slug is not re-derived from the new name as the task explicitly requires.

The queues nav gate passes the class name as the ability (@can('\App\Models\Queue::class', $currentEntity)) instead of @can('create', [Queue::class, $currentEntity]), so the Queues link will not render for managers.

Queue rows are clickable <div class="box p-2"> elements rather than the required <button class="button is-fullwidth p-3 mb-2"> with an aria-label, making them inaccessible and missing the contract markup.

Many labels are hard-coded in English (Cancel, Active/Inactive, Deactivate/Activate, Grant/Revoke, Confirm, Call next, Any/Priority/Normal, table headers, and 'No tickets.') instead of coming from lang/*/ui.php; the call button ignores ui.serve_call_next and the empty state ignores ui.serve_empty.
mode is a public, client-writable string that is never validated; CallMode::from($this->mode) throws ValueError on a tampered value, and an unknown mode skips the waiting-list filter.
callNext() has no RateLimiter, so successful calls are not rate-limited per user and entity as required and the CallNextTicket action can be hammered.

The same membership role is compared to enum ->value strings in Serve but to enum cases in the queue view; one comparison must be wrong, so either managers lose their callable queues or managers are given grant/revoke buttons.
The contract requires editingQueueId plus startRename($id) and toggleActive($id); the component instead adds an unused editingQueue boolean and both methods take no id.
lastCalledTicketId is public without #[Locked], although the task says it must not be writable by the client.
The view resolves viewingQueueId with find() and immediately dereferences $queue->name; a tampered or foreign id yields null and a 500 instead of a scoped not-found or a closed modal.
Interactive controls (create button, queue rows, rename/deactivate/access buttons, call-next and mode buttons) lack the aria-labels the task requires.

issues.location: change.diff (no tests directory or test cases)
issues.explanation: No Pest/PHPUnit tests were added for the new pages, authorization failures, tampering with ids or mode, rate limiting, translations, or the members tabs.
Docs and CHANGELOG were not updated as the project's keep-docs-in-sync convention requires.
Unused imports (Gate, Ticket, Queue) and fully-qualified class names in the routes despite the new imports add avoidable noise.

review.summary: The change adds Queues and Serve Livewire pages, language keys, routes and navbar links, but the implementation is not mergeable: the Queues page throws a TypeError before rendering, Serve exposes waiting tickets without authorizing call, the required Members tabs and rename UI/rate limiting are missing, and there are no tests. The code mostly reuses the domain actions and stays in scope, but it needs substantial rework and security fixes.
